errors.text_span: 其在x轴起始点（0）处的值为83.2%
errors.evidence: The chart has no data point at x=0. The data series begins at x=1.
The description omits the first data point of the series, which is at x=1 with a y-value of approximately 83.35%.
The peak value at x=2 is visibly above the 83.6% tick mark, at approximately 83.7%.
The data point at x=4 is not at 83.2%. It is visibly higher than the preceding point at x=3 (which is at 83.2%), located at approximately 83.25%.
The term 'stabilizes' is an interpretation of the trend. Moreover, it is factually incorrect, as the line shows a slight increase from x=3 to x=4.
